name: Somany Ceramics Ltd
title: Somany Ceramics Ltd - 531548 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gas-cost shock from the March 2026 war lifted tile prices 15-17%, Morbi capacity is shut and 10-15% may never restart, and management guides EBITDA margin up 150 bps+ from 9.3%, though April demand was slow and utilisation only ~79%.

capex.peers_comment: Morbi capacity shut; new plants unlikely for 18-24 months due to rupee-dollar and uncertainty.
capex.quote: everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment

triggers.label: Morbi 10-15% capacity may never restart
triggers.quote: The balance 10% to 15%, I don't think will run ever.

triggers.label: Tile price hike 16-17% since March
triggers.quote: the average price increase is around 16% to 17% as far as tile is concerned

triggers.label: New plants unlikely for 18-24 months
triggers.quote: new plants will not come for the next 18 to 24 months

triggers.label: Debtor days 51 to 40
triggers.quote: We have -- that particular figure is at 40 days, down from 51 days

triggers.label: April slow; Morbi volumes missed
triggers.quote: April has been slow for 2, 3 reasons.

guidance.value: at least 150 bps from FY26 9.3% base
guidance.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more
For the sanitaryware and adhesive business would be in very healthy double digits.
volume will be in a single -- very decent single digits for the tile business
everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment

red_flags.label: Pricing pass-through on projects only ~85-90%
red_flags.quote: where we have been able to pass on about 85% of the cost

red_flags.label: Dealers stocking up on cheaper material, April demand slow
red_flags.quote: we have dumped a lot of material as an industry

evasions.topic: Gas price outlook and sustainability of pricing
evasions.quote: So difficult to give you a prediction on the value number
